errors.text_span: 且两个模型的F1值在不同类别间差异不大
errors.evidence: The phrase "差异不大" (the difference is not large) is a subjective assessment of the magnitude of the difference between values, which constitutes interpretation rather than a neutral description of the data.

errors.text_span: 图表清晰地展示了CHSDETECTOR模型在两个类别上的分类性能均优于RoBERTa模型。
errors.evidence: The phrase "优于" (superior to) is an evaluative judgment about model performance. A neutral description should state that one model has higher F1 values, not that its performance is superior.
